reasons.label: Match result
reasons.text: RB Leipzig are favoured at 54%, against 25% for Manchester City FC and 21% for the draw. RB Leipzig carry 52 more Elo points into the match. Over the last five: RB Leipzig 1.8 points per game, Manchester City FC 1.2. They average 3.0 points per game at home this season.

reasons.label: Goals
reasons.text: The model expects 3.90 goals, which puts it over 2.5 at 75%. Across their last five, RB Leipzig and Manchester City FC have scored 1.9 and conceded 2.0 a game between them.

reasons.text: Adjusted from this competition's own record: goals were predicted 3.11 against 3.63 actual across 182 settled forecasts, so the rate is nudged up 16.9% to stop the model leaning under.
